description: For an infinite initial cardinal, the predecessor-rank map on its square is injective and takes values below its initial ordinal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareRank_injection.{u} (c : Cardinal.{u}) (hc : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ c)
  (h : IsWellOrder (c.ord.ToType × c.ord.ToType) Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareLT) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareRank c h) ∧
    ∀ (p : c.ord.ToType × c.ord.ToType), Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteCardinalArithmetic.squareRank c h p < c.ord
